notes: SAFETY-CRITICAL. WebFetch had no DNS in the writing environment, so all rule wording was checked through search-index text restricted to the official domains (scca.com, fia.com, nhra.com/nhraracer.com, nasaproracing.com, sfifoundation.com); please open the linked PDFs/pages and confirm before publishing. Verified: SCCA Time Trials 3x tube diameter at centerline (online rules page, no edition number shown); FIA Art. 253 3x centreline radius in 2013/2019/2020 editions (2026 edition listed WMSC 23.06.2026 but not read); NHRA TIG for 4130 in 2017 and 2019 General Regulations and 2024 Exhibition supplement (2026 rulebook is a paid document, not read); NHRA past editions pair .118 mild steel with .083 4130 (OD varies by section/class, deliberately not stated). Eastwood High Capacity lower OD bound conflicts between kit (3/4 in) and fact-check notes (1 in), so the article says 'up to 2 in OD' only. Eastwood 90 deg max with 120 deg dies / 180 with 240 deg dies is from the Eastwood 21115Q PDF as recorded in the fact-check notes. Rogue Fab M605/M625 4130 ratings were not found, article says 'ask Rogue Fab'.
